method.preprocessing: training-fold median/mode imputation, numeric standard scaling, one-hot encoding; unseen categories ignored

cath_vs_vessel_or.relation_checked: Cath == CAD iff at least one of LAD, LCX, or RCA == Stenotic

duplicates.patient_identity_limit: No patient identifier is available; distinct rows cannot be confirmed to represent distinct people.

integrity.pure_level_note: These descriptive in-sample value counts are a leakage screen, not feature selection or evidence of a causal/deterministic mechanism.

subgroups.interpretation: Descriptive cohort summaries only; not fairness analyses, independent validation, or reliable conclusions for small strata.

interpretation_limits: Repeated internal cross-validation on the same 303-row cohort is not external validation.
Group ablations describe this fixed logistic pipeline and do not establish causal contribution or production replacement.
Held-out group masking evaluates inference-time imputation after training on complete data; it does not validate missingness generalization.
No clinical or fairness claims follow from these small descriptive analyses.
Feature measurement timing is undocumented; any post-test or workflow leakage requires clinical review.
